difficulty_reason: Prove the four stacks in groupoids [B/G], [[B/G]], G-Torsors, G/B-Torsors are canonically equivalent (and also equivalent to G-Principal when G -> B is flat and locally of finite presentation): the equivalence G-Torsors -> G/B-Torsors is lemma-compare-torsors; the equivalence [B/G] -> [[B/G]] is proposition-equal-quotient-stacks; unwinding the definition of [[B/G]] from section-group-quotient-stacks gives [[B//G]] = G-Torsors; for the flat lfp case, show a principal homogeneous G_U-space X -> U is fppf locally trivial - by spaces-groupoids-definition-principal-homogeneous-space there is an fpqc covering {U_i -> U} trivializing X, whence X -> U is surjective, flat and lfp by the three spaces-descent descending-property lemmas, and choosing an etale surjection W -> X makes {W -> U} an fppf covering with X_W -> W a section, so X is an fppf G_U-torsor. Statement carries the author's slogan environment.
